name: Botein
description: A star 52 parsecs away, 9.7 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 14838: radius 9.745 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 50.038 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.052) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 14838: effective temperature 4921 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.056)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 2.36 from 2024A&A...682A.145S; the 21 published values span log g 2.36 to 3.05, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.3% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 14838: distance 52.029 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.01), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 52 parsecs away, 9.7 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 50 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,921 K, so 9.745 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 14838: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Delta Arietis
quotes.card: Delta Arietis is a star in the northern constellation of Aries, positioned 1.8 degrees north of the ecliptic.
quotes.introduction: Its identifier is a Bayer designation that is Latinized from δ Arietis, and abbreviated Delta Ari or δ Ari.
